import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a forum post. The placeholders will be filled with # the sanitized header, message and options list. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{header}

{message}

{options} """ def _sanitize_html(text: str) -> str: """ Escape all HTML special characters in *text* to prevent XSS attacks. This function also normalizes the input by stripping leading/trailing whitespace and collapsing internal newlines to a single space. """ # Strip surrounding whitespace and collapse multiple spaces/newlines cleaned = " ".join(text.strip().split()) return html.escape(cleaned, quote=True) def _render_options(options: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a list of options as an unordered HTML list. Each option is sanitized to escape any potentially malicious content. """ if not options: return "" list_items = [] for opt in options: sanitized_opt = _sanitize_html(opt) list_items.append(f"
  • {sanitized_opt}
    • ") return "
      \n" + "\n".join(list_items) + "\n
    " def generate_forum_post(header: str, message: str, options: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML forum post. Parameters ---------- header : str The user-written title of the post. message : str The body text of the post. options : list[str] A list of user-submitted options (in markdown format). Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string containing the header, message and options. """ # Sanitize each component safe_header = _sanitize_html(header) safe_message = _sanitize_html(message) # Render options into an unordered list safe_options = _render_options(options) # Format the final post using the provided template return FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( header=safe_header, message=safe_message, options=safe_options )
